title: Share planning-field and cleared-blocker facts for history rendering
outcome: Share planning-field and cleared-blocker facts for history rendering
acceptance: Stored WorkChangeSummary and transient HistoryDisplay reuse one facts derivation with unchanged stored bytes, avoiding duplicate planning and blocker reads.

completion.summary: HistoryDisplay::load is the single read of a history event's planning-field and cleared-blocker facts; stored_summary() builds the stored WorkChangeSummary from them with the unchanged builder, and fresh delivery, focus history and record windows each load once. Stored and delivered bytes unchanged. Store judgment: none; readiness ready on all 4 stores.
